title: Prefill-aware Kernel Quality Estimator and Staged Rollout for v2/v3
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: We observed non-deterministic decode jitter and occasional output-quality regressions when autoswitching to FlashAttention v3 under cold/warm prefill conditions. This ticket implements a Prefill-aware Kernel Quality Estimator (DQE) and a staged rollout plan that ties kernel selection to an online quality+latency utility rather than raw latency heuristics alone. Goals: 1) reduce production regressions caused by v3 warmup/tiling edge cases, 2) preserve the v3 latency/cost benefits for stable workloads, 3) enable safe canaries that block switchover on signal of output-quality degradation. Design: - DQE (Dynamic Quality Estimator): lightweight estimator that consumes per-request telemetry (prefill length, batch size, matrix shapes, GPU occupancy, kernel-choice, token-level latencies) and predicts a short-term expected utility score: U = alpha*(latency_delta) + beta*(perplexity_delta proxy) + gamma*(OOM-risk). We use a Bayesian bandit variant to update kernel priors per-tenant and per-shape fingerprint. - Prefill-aware fingerprinting: add a fingerprint key that incorporates prefill token histogram (buckets: short <64, medium 64-512, long >512) and decode burstiness metric. This lets DQE detect scenarios where v3 tile-layout causes fragmentation/regression. - Canary gating: canary rollout controlled by three signals over 1-hour windows: median token-latency delta, 95th token-latency delta, and eval-set output divergence score (approximate perplexity computed via a lightweight ngram-proxy on representative eval prompts). All must be within configurable thresholds for promotion. - Fallback & pinning: runtime supports per-tenant kernel pinning via config flag and a fast rollback endpoint. When DQE posterior crosses a safety threshold, runtime pins that tenant to v2 and emits an alert with suggested repro workload. - Test harness: long-tail synthetic suite (longstream-burst) with: varied prefill distributions, head-slicing patterns, quantized-weights scenarios. We add deterministic replay for production sampled traces for retrospective analysis. Acceptance criteria: - Canary passes on 10 tenants for 24h with no quality regressions (eval-proxy delta <0.5%) and token-latency improvement >= 8% on stable workloads. - Observability: heatmap in Console showing per-tenant kernel-priority drift, per-shape utility score, and a reproducible repro link for each regression. - Rollback time < 60s. Implementation plan: 1) proto DQE in dev cluster (feature branch: feat/dqe-prefill), implement metric collection hook and fingerprint generation. 2) Run offline eval across historical traces and synthetic suite; calibrate alpha/beta/gamma. 3) Canary on internal tenants + 3 low-risk external tenants. 4) Progressive rollout with automatic pinning on failures and manual unblock flow. Trade-offs & rationale: - We accept slightly higher CPU on-request to compute fingerprint and proxy-perplexity in exchange for fewer false-positive kernel swaps. - Using an ngram-proxy avoids cost of full-model scoring for canaries; it's conservative but fast. - Chose Bayesian bandit to balance exploration (discover v3 wins in new shapes) vs. exploitation (avoid oscillation). Observability & telemetry: - New metrics: kernel_quality_score, kernel_selection_reason, prefill_histogram_bucket, token_latency_stream. - Dashboards: Prefill Quality dashboard in Console and an alert runbook mapped to the ticket. Artifacts & links: - Design doc (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Prefill+DQE - Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3248 - Canary dashboard (internal): https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/serve/prefill-dqe-canary - Synthetic suite: gs://redwood-test-longstream/longstream-burst-v1.zip Rollout & rollback plan: - Feature toggle off by default. Enable DQE in dev → staging → limited-production canaries. - Auto-pin threshold: utility_drop > 0.12 sustained for 10 minutes triggers auto-pin. - Manual rollback: ops can set tenant.kernel_pin=true via console API; change takes effect immediately. Success metrics & monitoring: - Reduction in v3-triggered regressions to <1 incident/month over initial 30 tenants. - 95th percentile token-latency delta tracked per-tenant and aggregated. - Telemetry retention: 7 days for traces, 90 days for aggregated metrics.
